card: Adds a test case to wallet_startup.py checking that reloading an already-registered wallet with load_on_startup=True skips writing settings and emits no warnings under -nosettings. This improves coverage for the dynamic settings short-circuit logic merged in PR #36176. The edge case was suggested during review of PR #36176.

risk.why: A flaw in this change would only result in a test failure.
